No P disposition needs reversal; no rejection is false.

- Independently re-verified 8 claim areas against public primary sources: Grist access rules (live fetch confirms column rules + S-bypass verbatim), Snipe-IT #19174 (open, confirmed), ERPNext v15.117.0 (verbatim #57110 fix, confirmed), NocoDB gating (upgraded from forum thread to official license docs — correction stands), n8n executions (numbers hold; source must upgrade to official docs; EUR/USD drift noted), Authentik 2025.10 no-Redis (upgraded from third-party guide to official blog/release), PowerSync upload buffering (confirmed), Lend-Engine pricing (tiers confirmed; found omitted item/contact/site caps + existing site-level i18n that narrows U-P3).

- [sources/evidence.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-08/treatment/critic/sources/evidence.md) and [sources/index.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-08/treatment/critic/sources/index.md) — bounded excerpts + navigable finding map.
